attributes.title: NYSSPA 2027 CME Conference
attributes.organizer: New York State Society of Physician Associates
attributes.summary:
The New York State Society of Physician Associates holds its 2027 CME Conference from Friday, October 15, to Sunday, October 17, 2027, at the Albany Capital Center in downtown Albany. CME is scheduled on all three days.

NYSSPA is collecting presentation proposals until January 31, 2027. The program, CME hours and registration fees have not been published yet. Parking at the Albany Capital Center costs $12 per car per day.
